title: [UI][Sorting] Changing the sort does not change the cart contents
precondition: Standard user is logged in on the Products page with an empty cart and the default sort (Name A to Z).

steps.action: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Onesie" to the cart
steps.expected: The cart badge shows 2; both products show a "Remove" button
The cart badge still shows 2; "Remove" is shown only on Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie; the other four products show "Add to cart"
The cart badge still shows 2; "Remove" is shown only on Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie; the other four products show "Add to cart"
The cart badge still shows 2; "Remove" is shown only on Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie; the other four products show "Add to cart"
The cart lists exactly Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Onesie ($7.99), quantity 1 each, and the badge shows 2

gherkin:
Given my cart holds "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Onesie"
When I change the sort through "Name (Z to A)", "Price (low to high)" and "Price (high to low)"
Then the cart badge always shows 2
And only those two products show "Remove"
And the cart page lists the same two products with the same prices
